# AI-Conducted Screening Interview

[← Snowflake](../README.md) · [Every Snowflake question](../../snowflake.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/ai-conducted-screening)

`ai-screening` `ai-tools` `deep-dive` `new-round` `verbal`

---

## Requirements

- An automated AI-led screening is sent to applicants for general SWE roles; it must be finished within seven days of receiving the invitation and takes roughly 20 minutes.
- You need to grant access to your microphone, camera, and entire screen. The left side displays a real-time transcript of both your responses and the AI's remarks, while the right side shows your video feed.
- It begins with logistical checks, including relocation willingness, work authorization, and comparable screening items.
- The main portion is an adaptive exploration of your experience—the AI picks up terms from your responses and pursues them with increasingly specific questions:
  - say you created something with Java → “which part proved most difficult?” → reply “distributed …” → “how did you address that in a distributed environment?”
  - mention a project covering Slack / Teams / email → “those platforms differ substantially in many ways—how did you manage those differences?”
- It invariably asks how your present employer incorporates AI tools into its work processes.
- It ends by asking whether you have questions; for details about visa sponsorship or internal AI tools, the AI redirects you to HR or the company website.

## Notes

- The follow-up questions are truly generated from your responses rather than pulled from a fixed script—any answer may trigger a more detailed inquiry, so organize every story clearly and be prepared to explore anything you mention for two or three layers.
- Consider the question about your company's AI-tool use a guaranteed part of the interview; it echoes the same topic in the human HR or behavioral screen. Give specific tools and a brief reason for using them instead of avoiding the question.
- Since the session captures your video, screen, and transcript, it counts as an assessed interview stage rather than an informal chatbot trial.

## Preparation

- Draft two or three project narratives, giving each a distinct path into its “most difficult part” that you can develop when prompted, and practice taking each story two further levels down.
- Formulate a specific response about your current AI-tool usage: identify the tools, explain their purposes, and estimate approximately what portion of your work they represent.
- Test your camera, microphone, and full-screen sharing in advance so configuring permissions does not consume part of the 20-minute session.
